description: Type your details once and get a clean, professional resume preview. Print it or save it as a PDF straight from your browser — no sign-up needed.

faqs.a: Fill in the form fields and the preview updates live. Then click Print / Save as PDF and choose "Save as PDF" in your browser's print dialog.
faqs.q: How do I save my resume as a PDF?

faqs.a: No. Everything stays in your browser on your own device. Nothing is uploaded or stored anywhere.
faqs.q: Is my personal data uploaded anywhere?

faqs.a: The builder keeps one entry per line, so list each role, degree or certificate on its own line in the right order.
faqs.q: Can I add multiple jobs or degrees?

howto: Fill in your contact details and summary.
Add experience lines, education and skills.
Watch the resume preview update live.
Use Print / Save as PDF to export your resume.
title: Resume Builder
